summary: Ngin-ui là giao diện web (WebUI) cho Nginx, cho phép quản lý cấu hình, reload và proxy settings trực tiếp từ trình duyệt mà không cần sửa file config thủ công.
usecases: Manage multiple Nginx instances from a single dashboard in development or staging environments
Quick reload Nginx configurations after changes without SSH access to servers
Visual interface for beginners to adjust proxy rules and SSL settings
ideas: Auto-generate Nginx config from a visual editor and deploy automatically via CI/CD pipelines
Integrate with Let's Encrypt for automatic SSL certificate generation and renewal
Build a "Nginx as a Service" platform for SaaS hosting and multi-tenant environments
